name: Stellar Desktop API v2
frameworkTarget: Laravel 12.69.0; approved exact 73-package runtime installed locally without scripts/plugins

layers.Application: Use cases, gateway interfaces and application errors
layers.Infrastructure: Local fixtures now; approved Stellar service adapters later
layers.Http: Thin Laravel controllers and explicit response mapping
layers.Providers: Composition root; selects adapters, never business logic

rules: No old API controllers, vendor packages, credentials or production settings copied into this project.
No production URL defaults. No outbound HTTP clients implemented yet.
Only fixture mode in staging/testing can boot this foundation.
Login/logout return 503 until a reviewed identity adapter is connected; never simulate a successful authenticated session.
Server catalog is test data, not live availability or working VPN configurations.
Models are DTOs, not a second users/subscriptions database. Existing Stellar services remain authoritative.
Domain and Application must not import Laravel or infrastructure adapters.
Local runtime/kernel tests and isolated Azure HTTPS smoke tests pass. No live identity, account creation, revocation or VPN integration is connected.
next: Desktop server-catalog adapter now consumes staging v2 fixtures; keep live VPN/authentication disabled until reviewed adapters exist.
Implement reviewed identity/device/subscription/VPN adapters against isolated test services.
Add rate limiting, authenticated-route middleware, account/device authorization, secret storage and logout revocation semantics before enabling live authentication.
